future_operational_custody.payload_timing_boundary: Starts with the future runner and ends after the durable payload publication returns.
future_operational_custody.receipt_rule: The receipt is written/fsynced after the measured payload boundary; it has no self-inclusive timing or self-hash claim.
future_operational_custody.failure_retention: A typed incomplete package or its original progress tree is retained before any secondary filesystem error is reported.

progress_bound.derivation: floor(268435456 / 1024) gives the hard safe event cap. Retention grows linearly in events; the latest checkpoint is not an event-history rewrite. The cap stops before a capacity breach and is not a future completion claim.
progress_bound.cadence_scope: Monotonic sampling at eligible guarded opportunities; not a real-time scheduling guarantee.

fixed_regression_scope.allowed: Lower-level fixed static, arithmetic, synthetic, mock, temporary-Git, telemetry-parser, and temporary-artifact helpers only.

real key, signature, nonce, lock, allocation, RUN directory, or scientific artifact
